## Summary

Describe the narrowly scoped change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass
- [ ] Full test suite passes
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples are updated
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, datasets, weights, or generated run artifacts are included
- [ ] Performance claims include identical-workload raw artifacts and regressions

## Compatibility and risk

Describe behavior changes, rollback steps, and any unverified hardware paths.
